name: Pollinator Road
why_visit: Lamp-moth traffic and a livestock lighter. The road is the herd, and one raider wants the pen.

bodies.name: Moth Lane
bodies.blurb: The pollinator road. Moths and a lighter share the lane.
bodies.legal: Garden shard. Lamp-moth traffic has the right of way. A core is not this pocket.
bodies.air: Warm dust. The moths like it.
bodies.life: Lamp-moths in the lane. The herd is in the lighter.
bodies.ruins: A lighter that spilled a pen and was not forgiven.

bodies.name: Lamp Perch
bodies.blurb: Where the lamps rest between runs.
bodies.legal: A perch moon for the moth lamps. Do not cut the lamps.
bodies.life: Moths. No crop until someone brings seed home.

belt.name: Wing Scale
belt.composition: lamp-moth scale and perch glass shed along the pollinator road
belt.legal: Moth scale. The road is amber. The lamps are not a belt.

trash.name: Dropped Pens
trash.origin: Pens that slipped a lighter on the pollinator road and were never hauled back.
trash.legal: Dropped pens. The herd is gone. The lighter still runs.

pocket.name: Perch Pocket
pocket.why: The moths use this pocket. It is not on the claim slate.

duties: Raider over Pollinator Road. Take the livestock lighter inside 1100 meters. The pen is the prize.

haulers.name: Moth Tender
haulers.duty: Moth Tender on Pollinator Road. Walk the perch pocket and keep the lamps with the herd.

haulers.name: Lighter Pilot
haulers.duty: Lighter Pilot on Pollinator Road. Hold the livestock tow. Come within 480 meters and the lighter matches your nose.
